caption: Year, month and day groups in date order.
eval: return (async () => { await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Date Hierarchy/Projects.base#By month', '', false); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1400)); const root = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-date-hierarchy'); if (!root) throw new Error('Missing date hierarchy'); [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Expand all').click(); if (root.querySelectorAll('.bdh-row').length !== 6 || root.querySelectorAll('details').length !== 10) throw new Error('Expected six notes and ten date groups'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Collapsed years with counts.
eval: return (async () => { await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Date Hierarchy/Projects.base#By month', '', false); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1400)); const root = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-date-hierarchy'); if (!root) throw new Error('Missing date hierarchy'); [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Collapse all').click(); if (root.querySelector(':scope > details[open]')) throw new Error('Groups did not collapse'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Oldest year first with undated notes last.
eval: return (async () => { await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Date Hierarchy/Projects.base#Oldest first', '', false); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1400)); const root = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-date-hierarchy'); if (!root) throw new Error('Missing date hierarchy'); if (!root.querySelector(':scope > details > summary').textContent.includes('2025')) throw new Error('Expected oldest year first'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Example Pro ISO week ranges and sums with a test sponsorship response.
eval: return (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-date-hierarchy']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'test-example' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-date-hierarchy-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Date Hierarchy/Projects.base#Pro weeks', '', false); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1400)); const root = document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-date-hierarchy'); if (!root) throw new Error('Missing date hierarchy'); [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Expand all').click(); if (!root.textContent.includes('2025-12-29 to 2026-01-04') || !root.querySelector('.bdh-summary')) throw new Error('Missing ISO week range or summary'); return 'ok'; })()
